props.question: How does an engagement begin?
props.answer: With a free conversation to understand your situation, followed by a written proposal with scope, timing and fees.

props.question: Do you work with smaller organisations?
props.answer: Yes. Many of our clients are growing businesses, and we scale our teams to suit.

props.question: Who will we work with?
props.answer: A named partner leads every engagement and stays involved until it is finished.

props.question: Is our information kept confidential?
props.answer: Always. Every engagement is covered by a confidentiality agreement.
